title: Chapter 75: The Dragon Returns To The Sea And Stirs Up Storms
content:
Chapter 75: The Dragon Returns To The Sea And Stirs Up Storms

"volley!"

With a look of excitement on his face, he ordered the volley to fire again.

He has never fought such a satisfying battle. He was almost unscathed, and the enemy was almost completely annihilated!

After another salvo, Hydralisk, under Wu Qing's order, jumped out of the formation and launched continuous long-range attacks on the army of evil believers with few remaining troops.

Search TWKAN on GOOGLE

The puppy followed the hydralisk and pressed forward.

At this time, the army of evil god believers has not chosen to retreat!

This was the scene that frightened the local races the most, but it turned out to be a good thing for Wu Qing. Although these evil god believers could not escape the Zerg's pursuit by running away, their gathering together in this way made it easier for the Zerg to quickly encircle and suppress them.

Two thousand hydralisks, led by one star hydralisks, withstood sporadic long-range attacks and continuously sprayed spike attacks at the remaining army of evil god believers.

The dense Zerg spikes like a violent storm swept the last followers of the evil god to the ground.

More than 30,000 evil god believer troops stationed nearby were quickly wiped out by the alliance army.

The losses of the Alliance army were very slight. The most serious losses were Zerg puppies, which numbered just over 10,000. This did not include those injured puppies that had gone underground to recuperate.

Hydralisks and the alliance's elite troops suffered almost no losses, with only a few minor casualties.

This is a brilliant victory! This is a battle that boosts the morale of the alliance's elite troops!

With this victory, the Alliance army becomes more fearless!

The alliance army can achieve such results because our side is too strong and the enemy is too weak.

After the Brood was upgraded to one star, the Zerg troops underwent a comprehensive upgrade, which effectively improved the combat capabilities of the Zerg troops.

Those who cooperate with the Zerg in fighting are the elites from the five major territories of the alliance, and their combat power is very powerful. Adding these two together, the combat power can be imagined.

As for the evil god’s army, the ones that arrived fastest this time were the ordinary garrison troops at the outermost edge. They were similar to the armies of the cattle, rat, snake, cat, pig and other races outside the Tengu clan’s camp. They were even the sacrificial troops. No-name troops without them have weak combat power.

If they encounter an ordinary army, they can still play some role. But if they encounter a killing machine like the Alliance army, the outcome will be obvious.

"Look what needs to be cleaned up on the battlefield? We will move soon!"

Wu Qing said to Meng that the evil god's army camp might not have reacted to such a fast battle. The puppy worked hard to encircle and suppress the enemy's scouts and patrols on the periphery, which played a role.

It is safe here for the time being, but there is no time to clean up the supplies scattered all over the battlefield.

"Let's see if there are any usable arrows, throwing spears and hand axes, but don't need anything else!"

After thinking for a while, he arranged for some cavalry to collect long-range weapons.

The long-range attack weapons you use should be saved as much as possible. You can also replenish some of the throwing spears from the enemy. The Yu Clan's arrow speed and the Stone Clan's hand ax cannot be replenished from the outside world.

There were very few armies with bows and arrows and hand axes in this area.

Wu Qing asked the idle puppy to help and quickly found everything he needed.

The Alliance army began to move.

According to normal logic, such a battle of annihilation would surely lead to a full-scale encirclement and suppression by the enemy, so now we should retreat to the Tengu Clan's camp.

But Wu Qing didn't think so. The war had already started, so there was no need to end it so early.

With the resources supplemented by this war, the eighty Zerg broods are going all out to attack.

When necessary, Wu Qing will choose to consume resources and upgrade some one-star nests to ensure the speed of the Zerg's troops.

"Bai Yan, take people over and drive away the Tengu cavalry who are following you!"

"Tell them that if they don't leave now, they will risk their own lives and deaths!"

Wu Qing said to Bai Yan that this battle could be used to promote the alliance army. He didn't want outsiders to continue to watch the subsequent Zerg battles.

"good!"

Bai Yan responded, leading a group of wolf cavalry and rushing towards the Tengu cavalry responsible for surveillance.

I don’t know what Bai Yan said to the Tengu cavalry. The large Tengu cavalry responsible for surveillance chose to leave, leaving only a small team, preparing to continue to move with the alliance army.

When they discovered that the Alliance army had organized its team, continued to advance towards the so-called target position under the leadership of the guide, and plunged into the back of the evil god army's camp, the Tengu cavalry who left were dumbfounded.

The reason why they chose to leave readily was because they felt that the Alliance army was going back anyway, and there was no need for so many people to follow them. Unexpectedly, the Alliance army had no intention of going back at all.

"This alliance army has fought such a battle and is ready to deliver its mission. Why should it continue to complete its mission?"

"If you go on a mission while being completely exposed, isn't that going to your death?"

The puzzled Tengu cavalry leader asked the adjutant beside him.

"Afraid that you will be punished if you fail to complete the task?"

The adjutant responded quietly.

"Do you think it's possible?!"

They had seen the attitude of the Alliance army. The Tengu tribe did not want to see the Alliance army. The Alliance army was also very unhappy with the Tengu tribe. The two sides almost came to blows.

"Then do you still want to follow?"

"Still following you? I'm afraid we'll really die!"

"It would be great to be able to collect this information! Let us wish the brothers who follow us good luck!"

"Let's go! Let's go back and report first!"

Faced with Bai Yan's warning, these Tengu cavalrymen dared not return to follow.

Since the Alliance Army came here to warn, the danger of continuing to follow and monitor can be imagined. This is the place where the evil god's believers' army roams everywhere, and it is the enemy's territory. It is very logical for them to disappear suddenly.

They guessed correctly. Not long after the Alliance Army left, the Tengu cavalry squad following the Alliance Army suddenly disappeared in the jungle without leaving any trace.

In the southern area of the entire evil god army camp, all the scouts and patrol teams outside were attacked by the puppies who came from the Zerg territory.

In the surrounding areas of the entire evil god army camp, there are puppies lurking and scouting, and continuously passing information to the Queen and Wu Qing.

Including around the Tengu tribe's camp, there are puppies lurking to scout the movements of the Tengu tribe army.

With such battlefield intelligence capabilities, Wu Qing led the alliance army and could calmly avoid the enemy's search and wait for the arrival of the Zerg army to gather again.

The Zerg entering the battlefield is like a dragon returning to the sea, which will inevitably stir up the storm!

If there is a chance, Wu Qing will let the two camps fight in advance. As long as the war breaks out, the Tengu tribe will not have so much time and energy to keep an eye on the alliance army.

The advantages of the Zerg can be fully utilized, making this war a stage for the Zerg to enter this world!
